# Canberra Vasectomy

> No-scalpel vasectomy by Dr John Deery in Canberra — Experienced, comfortable, and convenient.

Canberra Vasectomy is a specialist vasectomy clinic operated by Dr John Deery, Canberra's most experienced local vasectomy surgeon with over 8,000 procedures performed and more than 750 vasectomies per year, accounting for approximately 80% of ACT vasectomies (based on MBS item 37623 statistics). The clinic is part of the YourGP network of general practices in Canberra.

## Key Information

- **Phone**: (02) 6103 0434 (10am to 5pm, Monday to Friday)
- **Booking**: Online via [HotDoc](https://www.canberravasectomy.com.au/bookings) or by phone
- **Billing**: Private billing. Medicare rebates processed on the day. Not bulk billed.
- **New patients**: Welcome. No GP referral required.
- **Accepting new patients**: Yes

## Reviews

- **★ 5.0 from 214 Google reviews** — [view on Google](https://yourgp.group/VasectomyReviews)
- Also discussed on [Reddit](https://yourgp.group/reditreviews)

## Procedure

- **Technique**: No-scalpel open-ended vasectomy with fascial interposition
- **Anaesthesia**: Local anaesthetic only. Optional anxiety management: sleeping tablet pre-med (script from Dr Deery, collected from pharmacy, typically under $10) and/or Penthrox 'green whistle' inhaler ($85, supplied by clinic). Either option requires no driving for 24 hours.
- **Duration**: Approximately 10-15 minutes
- **Recovery**: Return to work on Monday (procedures done Thursday/Friday)
- **Effectiveness**: Greater than 99.85% success rate
- **Aftercare**: 3 months included, Dr Deery's mobile phone number provided

## Fees

- **Total out of pocket**: $723.30 (procedure $707 + initial consult $16.30, after Medicare rebates)
- **Vasectomy procedure**: $935 ($707 out of pocket after Medicare rebate of $228)
- **Initial consultation**: $60 ($16.30 after Medicare rebate of $43.70) — face-to-face or telehealth
- **Deposit**: $200 (paid at booking, subtracted from fee, refundable with 24 hours notice)
- **Optional sedation — sleeping tablet**: Dr Deery provides a script you collect from your pharmacy (typically under $10, paid to the pharmacy)
- **Optional sedation — Penthrox ('green whistle')**: $85, supplied by the clinic on the day
- **Driving note**: If you use either sedation option, you cannot drive for 24 hours; please arrange a driver or companion

## Practitioner

### Dr John Deery
Dr John Deery graduated from UNSW in 2000. He has recently stepped back from general practice and now provides vasectomy-only services. He performs over 750 vasectomies per year and has been performing vasectomies for over 20 years. John is married to Dr Mel Deery and they have three children. Before medicine, he played first-grade NRL for the Sydney Roosters and the St George Dragons.

**Work days**: Crace (Thursday/Friday procedures), Denman (Monday), Lyneham (Wednesday)

## Regional NSW Patients

Telehealth initial consultations are available to all patients. Dr Deery performs over 100 vasectomies per year for men from regional NSW — patients travel from across the Riverina, Central West and Southern Tablelands NSW, and the South Coast (Batemans Bay to Bega). They arrange an initial consultation via telehealth and then attend Canberra for the procedure only.

**Towns patients have travelled from include:** West Wyalong, Narrandera, Cootamundra, Junee, Wagga Wagga, Young, Cowra, Forbes, Tumut, Gundagai, Batlow, Tumbarumba, Cooma, Adaminaby, Jindabyne, Goulburn, Queanbeyan, Batemans Bay, Moruya, Narooma, Bermagui, Merimbula, Eden, Bega.

**Procedure day:** Arrive 5 minutes before booked time at YourGP@Crace (1/5 Baratta Street, Crace). Total time on-site is approximately 20 minutes. Without sedation, patients can drive themselves home; with sedation, no driving for 24 hours and a driver/companion is required.
